title: Ticket MCP startup diagnostics and incremental reconciliation
command: cargo test --manifest-path workflow-tools/Cargo.toml -p ticket -p ticket-api --all-features --locked -j 1 -- --exact --skip ui
detail: Standalone Ticket MCP startup optimization, not Mission G6. Excludes three previously documented offline trybuild ui tests. Covers warm unchanged rows, description changes, deletion, root discovery, ignore/reinclude, index recovery, stdio protocol and startup diagnostics.
